npcs.name: Left Move Tutor
says: Buhahaha! You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER. I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you! … … … … … … What is it now? You don't believe me. I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented! Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves. But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
Buhahaha! Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?

npcs.name: Right Move Tutor
says: Ihihihi! I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER. I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you! … … … … … … What's wrong? You don't believe me. I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced! I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves. But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
Ihihihi! Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful. They were idols among us TRAINERS. Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities. In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished. But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this… Time is so cruel…

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling! I like POKéMON CONTESTS more! But I'm no good at CONTESTS! I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.

npcs.name: Man
says: What a TRAINER needs… Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability… Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building! Huh? POKéMON? What's that?

npcs.name: Woman
says: Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS? That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Old Woman
says: Dear, what do you think of this? Wouldn't this make a nice gift? It's…PRO…TE…IN? It sounds delicious, doesn't it?

npcs.name: Old Man
says: We came here to chaperon our grandson. But since we're here, we thought we should get some souvenirs.

npcs.name: Boy
says: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities don't allow the use of items during battles. That rule makes things tougher than they already are!

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: Wow! It's huge! The BATTLE TOWER feels special. It's different from the others.

npcs.name: Man1
says: My grand ambition is to conquer both the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON LEAGUE. And if my dream comes true… I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door if she will be friends with me!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! I just can't make it to the top! Since I'm out of options, maybe I can climb the outside…

npcs.name: Hex Maniac
says: I thrive in darkness… Yes… What is worthy of me? None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID… What say you to wandering in darkness and in utter and total desperation?

npcs.name: Black Belt1
says: I didn't sleep for a week, but then I put together the ultimate team! I can't see myself losing, no joke. We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!

npcs.name: Cook
says: ZIGG! I believe in you, little buddy! I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite tasty treats you like if you win!

npcs.name: Expert F
says: I may not look that impressive now, but I once beat a GYM LEADER. Who knows, maybe I should give it another shot at glory.

npcs.name: Triathlete M
says: Did SCOTT bring you here, too? What is it with that guy? It sounds like he really does know how to spot talented TRAINERS, but… I've never seen him battling in person ever.

npcs.name: Rich Boy
says: People call me a busybody, but I can't help it. Your hat's on crooked! Oh, no, trash on the ground! Oops, it's almost dinnertime! I don't know if I can stand to just watch at the BATTLE PALACE…

npcs.name: Triathlete F
says: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for the way I battle, too. I win matches in the blink of an eye!

npcs.name: Twin
says: I'm better than my daddy at POKéMON.

npcs.name: Man2
says: Go on, my baby sweetie! Go rack up some wins for Daddy! You're just like your mother, so you'll be dominating!

npcs.name: Zigzagoon
says: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…

npcs.name: Maniac1
says: It wasn't easy getting here, but I'd heard about this knockout pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA. Instead of her, do you know what I found? A whole teeming mob of sweaty, stinky, and primitive martial artists!

npcs.name: Girl
says: I sometimes see this really important- looking old man going in there. He has these really awesome POKéMON. He seems really nice, though.

npcs.name: Psychic M
says: Do you know it? The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID? When there comes a confident TRAINER reaching for the golden pinnacle, there shall appear a man among men. Don't know that legend? Well, of course not! I just made it up! What's it supposed to mean? That, my friend, I can't say!

npcs.name: Man3
says: Man! Oh man! I've never lost once before! But I got wiped out with no saving grace at all! And then I'm told I don't have any talent?! Man!

npcs.name: Woman1
says: This guy ran into a horribly tough TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE TOWER challenge. Now look at him… You need to be cautious if you ever decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.

npcs.name: Woman2
says: Yes! I've finally got enough Battle Points! I guess I'll trade for another giant plush DOLL!

npcs.name: Black Belt2
says: Oh, yeah, okay! So this is the RANKING HALL! I'd like to go down in history as a super champ and have my name recorded here for posterity.

npcs.name: Maniac2
says: With you by my side, I can do anything.

npcs.name: Woman3
says: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful! Ooh, I just can't wait anymore! Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM right this instant! If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, the power of our love will overcome everyone we meet. Why, before us, darling, everything will topple like dominoes!

npcs.name: Old Woman
says: Excuse me, young one. Have you good eyesight? There is an odd tree past here, and to my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
Excuse me, young one. Have you a good memory? I have this feeling there once was an odd tree past here.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively for tough TRAINERS. Many people with special abilities have been invited, it seems. That man SCOTT… He may have built this place to serve a bigger objective…

npcs.name: Camper
says: I… I saw it! There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON with a long tail up ahead! It was hiding under a boulder, and it kept staring at me!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE TOWER! Keep the win streak as the toughest TRAINER!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE PALACE! Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE ARENA! Let the toughest teams gather!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID! Advance through the Battle Quest!

npcs.name: Sign
says: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER Exchange your Battle Points!

npcs.name: Sign
says: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL Set your sights on new records!

npcs.name: Boy1
says: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!

npcs.name: Ferry Attendant
says: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
[name] doesn't have the TICKET… I'm terribly sorry. You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me! But where is the entrance?

npcs.name: Man1
says: It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know? Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here. That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.

npcs.name: Woman1
says: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER! I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!

npcs.name: Fat Man1
says: Munch, munch… It looks like this square's filled with tough people. Munch, munch…

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME? I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.

npcs.name: Maniac1
says: Hey, bro… Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?
Uh… I'm sure it'll be okay. I think… But remember that big scary guy? He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”

npcs.name: Maniac2
says: Hey, bro… Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?
Uh… I'm sure it'll be okay. I think… But remember that big scary guy? He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”

npcs.name: Man2
says: There used to be nothing here not all that long ago. But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.

npcs.name: Woman2
says: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three! … … … … … …
Yay! I won! I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
Oh, no… I lost. I guess I'm not very lucky today. I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge until tomorrow.

npcs.name: Camper
says: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. You can rent strong POKéMON there. But it makes me wonder. Who's raising those rental POKéMON?

npcs.name: Lass
says: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no matter what, until I get a Symbol.

npcs.name: Man3
says: The BATTLE FRONTIER… I've long dreamed about a place like it.

npcs.name: Fisherman1
says: I believe I'm the only person here who, for some unknown reason, would choose fishing over battling. Huh? You can't catch anything here? That's disappointing…

npcs.name: Fat Man2
says: Crunch, munch… A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE. She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way. Crunch, munch… She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me. It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough. Crunch, munch…

npcs.name: Woman3
says: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing! Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!

npcs.name: Boy2
says: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft! That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you! The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!

npcs.name: Old Man
says: Oh, shush! Keep that racket down! You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER! The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!

npcs.name: Man4
says: Those people squabbling over there… It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too. They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too. But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament. They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER. Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every day now.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER. It must be adorable. I'm sure of it… Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE DOME! Your path to the invincible superstar!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE PIKE! Choose one of three paths!

npcs.name: Sign
says: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! Seek out the toughest POKéMON!

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

Th-that card… Could it be… The GOLD CARD?! Oh, the gold color is brilliant! The four stars seem to sparkle! I've seen several TRAINERS with a SILVER CARD before, but, [name], you're the first TRAINER I've ever seen with a GOLD CARD! Okay, [name], please allow me the honor of resting your POKéMON!
I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
Thank you for waiting. We've restored your POKéMON to full health.

npcs.name: School Kid
says: There was someone here using a POKéMON I've never seen before. I never learned about it at TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least. I wonder where you can catch POKéMON like that.

npcs.name: Man
says: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA! I'd better get the right POKéMON from the PC Storage System.

npcs.name: Picnicker
says: Giggle… I'm going to go through every challenge with just this baby!

npcs.name: Skitty
says: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!

npcs.name: Mystery Gift Man
says: Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System. You must be [name]. There is a ticket here for you.
It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port. Why not give it a try and see what it is about?

npcs.name: Attendant
says: This is the RANKING HALL. This is where we recognize the immortal TRAINERS who left great records in BATTLE FRONTIER events.

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: Hi, is your name on this list?
Oh, is that right? If you saw your friend's name up here, I bet it would make you work harder!
Wow, that's super! I'll have to try harder, too!

npcs.name: Boy
says: Hmm… My name's not up there… Well, it's only natural since I haven't taken any challenges yet.

npcs.name: Sign
says: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE, and BATTLE FACTORY Records

npcs.name: Sign
says: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA, and BATTLE PYRAMID Records

npcs.name: Greeter
says: The front lines of POKéMON battling! Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!
We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE FRONTIER has to offer!

npcs.name: Facility Guide
says: I'm your guide to the various facilities here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

npcs.name: Rules Guide
says: I'm your guide to the basic rules that are common to all the challenges offered by the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

npcs.name: Frontier Pass Guide
says: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.

npcs.name: Scott
says: I must say I have the gift of knowing a good TRAINER when I see one. I'm so glad I had the foresight to bring you here!
I'll be expecting to hear even greater things about you now!
I'm expecting great things from you!

SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome! Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space. Anyway, [name], let me formally welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER. This is my dream come true. It took me years and years, but I've finally given shape to my dream.
On reflection, it was a terribly long journey… I left home alone on a quest to find strong TRAINERS. No one can imagine how much effort or time it took to make this real.

But that's all in the past. No point dwelling on that! All I want for you is to enjoy battling to your heart's content here. [name], I want you to have this as a memento for all the time our paths crossed on our journeys.

SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in the BATTLE FRONTIER? …Wait a second… Oh! Your FRONTIER PASS! You've collected the full set of silver symbols! That's more than impressive! You are tough, just as I suspected! Normally, I wouldn't do something like this, but this is a special time! I want you to have this. I'm sure you can put it to proper use.

SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER. …Wait a second… Oh, my disbelieving eyes! Your FRONTIER PASS! You've gathered up the full set of gold symbols! That's more than stupendous! You're incredible, just as I suspected! … … … … … … [name], you've got to accept this! I think you will be able to appreciate the value of my gift!
Your BERRY POCKET seems to be stuffed.

SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual. They all lead lives of their own. But when they're in a battle, it doesn't matter who they are. They're all the same! I love the purity of battle, where everyone is equal. That's why I go everywhere seeking TRAINERS who are serious about battling, and invite them here.
[name] obtained … Battle Point(s).

SCOTT: You can check your Battle Points on your FRONTIER PASS. The more success you have here at the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle Points you will collect. Use your Battle Points the way you see fit, like trading them for items.
SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you! How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row? That's fantastic! I want you to have this!
SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you! How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row? That's ridiculously spectacular! You've got to have this!

SCOTT: Have you met any of the FRONTIER BRAINS? Better yet, have you obtained any symbols from them? I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere. But I'm sure that seeing how tough you are will startle even them!
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle, right? I think I remember you working on a POKéDEX as well. Well, guess what? You may run into wild POKéMON in the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere… Fufufu!
Oops, well, if you have too much stuff, come back for this later.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: If POKéMON get tired, take them to a POKéMON CENTER. There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE TOWN right close by.

npcs.name: Birchs Bag
says: PROF. BIRCH: Whew… I was in the tall grass studying wild POKéMON when I was jumped. You saved me. Thanks a lot! Oh? Hi, you're [name]! This is not the place to chat, so come by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?

npcs.name: Rate Pokedex Or Register
says: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, [name]! Are you curious about how your POKéDEX is coming along?

PROF. BIRCH: Oh, [name]! I've already heard about you! It seems your POKéNAV's been upgraded with MATCH CALL. Well, I should register, too! That way, I'd be able to examine your POKéDEX even while you're out in the field. … … … … … …
Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough POKéMON to make it worthwhile.
Hmhm… So, you've seen … POKéMON, and you've caught … POKéMON…
Hmhm… On a nationwide basis… You've seen … POKéMON, and you've caught … POKéMON…

npcs.name: Boy
says: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in tall grass. If you want to catch POKéMON, you have to go into the tall grass and search.

says: ROUTE 101 OLDALE TOWN

npcs.name: Little Boy
says: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right into tall grass. The grass goes up my nose and… Fwafwafwafwafwa… Fwatchoo!

npcs.name: Boy
says: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of POKéMON!

says: ROUTE 102 PETALBURG CITY

says: ROUTE 102 OLDALE TOWN

npcs.name: Man
says: If you cross the sea from here, it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN. Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?

npcs.name: Rival
says: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found on ROUTE 103 include…
Oh, hi, [name]! …Oh, I see, my dad gave you a POKéMON as a gift. Since we're here, let's have a quick battle! I'll give you a taste of what being a TRAINER is like.
BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and that one that live on ROUTE 103…
Hey, it's [name]! …Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON. Since we're here, how about a little battle? I'll teach you what being a TRAINER's about!

npcs.name: Boy
says: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired… I should have brought a POTION…

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
says: The sea, huh? I wonder what it's like at the bottom of the sea?

npcs.name: Girl1
says: That seaside cottage is where MR. BRINEY lives. He was once a mighty sailor who never feared the sea, however stormy.

npcs.name: Boy1
says: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL, weaken the wild POKéMON first. It will be easier to catch if it's been poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.

npcs.name: Woman
says: You're a thief if you try to steal someone else's POKéMON. You should throw POKé BALLS only at wild POKéMON.

npcs.name: Girl2
says: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER. But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes, it's a challenge to battle. If you don't want to battle, stay out of their sight.

npcs.name: Expert F
says: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy soil, feel free to take them. But make sure you plant a BERRY in the same spot. That's common courtesy. Here, I'll share this with you.
The way you look, you must be a TRAINER, no? TRAINERS often make POKéMON hold BERRIES. It's up to you whether to grow BERRIES or use them.

npcs.name: White Herb Florist
says: This FLOWER SHOP started selling saplings recently. It made me so happy, I went overboard shopping. I don't need this WHITE HERB anymore. Would you take it, please?
This FLOWER SHOP started selling saplings recently. It made me so happy, I went overboard shopping. Where should I put them?

npcs.name: Boy2
says: I like filling my mouth with seeds, then spitting them out fast! You can have this, so you try it out! Use it on a POKéMON, and it will learn a move for firing seeds rapidly.
A word of advice! A TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only for one-time use. Once you use it, it's gone. Think twice before using it!

npcs.name: Rival
says: MAY: Oh, hi, [name]! DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with the MATCH CALL system, huh? We should register each other so we can get in contact anytime.
[name] registered MAY in the POKéNAV.
MAY: Oh, by the way, [name], how's your POKéDEX coming along?
Mine's looking pretty decent. So… How about a little battle?
MAY: Oh, what's the matter? Haven't you caught or raised your POKéMON very much? That's not very good for a TRAINER!
BRENDAN: Oh, hey, [name]! Cool, you had DEVON install the MATCH CALL system on your POKéNAV! Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.
[name] registered BRENDAN in the POKéNAV.
BRENDAN: [name], how's your POKéDEX? Have you filled in any pages yet?
Me, I'm doing great! Want to check out how good I am with a battle?
BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have any confidence in your POKéMON?
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty good with the way you handle POKéMON. But instead of only making them battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY. It's important to become friends with POKéMON, too.
MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?
MAY: You just became a TRAINER, [name]. I'm not going to lose!
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent at handling POKéMON. But, you know, you shouldn't just be making POKéMON battle. Like MR. BRINEY, it's important to become friends with your POKéMON.
BRENDAN: What's up? Want to have a battle with me?
BRENDAN: I know you just became a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!

npcs.name: Sign
says: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE

npcs.name: Sign
says: ROUTE 1O4 PETALBURG CITY

npcs.name: Sign
says: ROUTE 1O4 RUSTBORO CITY

says: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP

npcs.name: Sign
says: TRAINER TIPS In the HOENN region there are pairs of TRAINERS who challenge others for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called DOUBLE BATTLES. In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must send out two POKéMON, the one at the left of the list and the top one. Watch how POKéMON are lined up.

npcs.name: Briney
says: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass! Wait up, PEEKO!

Hm? You're [name]! You saved my darling PEEKO! We owe so much to you! What's that? You want to sail with me? Hmhm… You have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD and a package for SLATEPORT, then? Quite the busy life you must lead! But, certainly, what you're asking is no problem at all. You've come to the right man! We'll set sail for DEWFORD.

MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say! You're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD and a package to SLATEPORT. What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job! First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say! You're to deliver a package to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT. What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job! First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.
MR. BRINEY: Is that so? Your deliveries can wait? You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail!
MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then! Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

npcs.name: Peeko
says: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!

npcs.name: Shop Owner
says: Hello! This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop. Spreading flowers all over the world!
Your name is? [name]. That's a nice name. [name], would you like to learn about BERRIES?
Please come again!
[name], would you like to learn about BERRIES?

BERRIES grow on trees that thrive only in soft, loamy soil. If you take some BERRIES, be sure to plant one in the loamy soil again. A planted BERRY will soon sprout, grow into a plant, flower beautifully, then grow BERRIES again. I want to see the whole wide world filled with beautiful flowers. That's my dream. Please help me, [name]. Plant BERRIES and bring more flowers into the world.
Flowers bring so much happiness to people, don't they?

npcs.name: Wailmer Pail Girl
says: While BERRY plants are growing, water them with the WAILMER PAIL. Oh, another thing. If you don't pick BERRIES for a while, they'll drop off onto the ground. But they'll sprout again. Isn't that awesome? It's like they have the will to live.
Hello! The more attention you give to flowers, the more beautifully they bloom. You'll like tending flowers. I'm sure of it. You can have this.

npcs.name: Random Berry Girl
says: I'm trying to be like my big sisters. I'm growing flowers, too! Here you go! It's for you!
You can plant a BERRY and grow it big, or you can make a POKéMON hold it. But now they have a machine that mixes up different BERRIES and makes candies for POKéMON. I want some candy, too.

npcs.name: Victor
says: Hello! I take it you're a traveler. How's this? What do you say to taking on our family of four in a series of POKéMON battles?
Is that so? Drop in, if you change your mind!
That's the spirit! I like you!
Hey, all! I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young? You must be quite the TRAINER to beat my husband, though. It's my turn to battle now!
There's a strong TRAINER here! This one's really strong!
You're stronger than Mommy? Wow! But I'm strong, too! Really! Honestly!
This stinks… …Snivel… Grandma!

Oh, you don't want this? If you change your mind, tell me, okay?

Find a big tree that looks like it might drop some vines. Use SECRET POWER in front of the tree. Some vines should get free and drop down, so you can climb the tree. You'll find a lot of space for putting your favorite things. It'll be your own secret room… A SECRET BASE! You should make one, too. npcs.name: Hiker

Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand hasn't been seen. Perhaps it really was the MIRAGE TOWER…
Whoa… That was shocking. Sand rained down in chunks all of a sudden. What was it like inside? Were there sandy ghosts and such?

I see it! The tower of sand! The sand tower they called a mirage is clearly visible! But it looks so fragile… It could crumble away anytime… I want to go inside it, but I can't get my courage up for it…

npcs.name: Vicky

npcs.name: Expert F
says: Oh, you like hot springs, do you? That's surprising for one as young as you.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: We draw as much hot water as we need, and yet the hot springs never run dry. Isn't it magical? These hot springs appear near active volcanoes. Veins of water under the ground are heated by magma to well up as hot springs.

npcs.name: Old Man
says: Being buried in this hot sand is… Sigh… So warm and heavenly… Eh? Gyaah! Ouch! A POKéMON nipped my backside!

npcs.name: Twin
says: I bathe in the hot springs every day. I want to become a beautiful and strong GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.

npcs.name: Hot Springs Old Woman1
says: If people put POKéMON in hot springs, it might be seriously strange. Why, it might be an electric bath, or a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…

npcs.name: Hot Springs Old Woman2
says: They're claiming that these hot springs are good for calming nervous tension, relieving aching muscles, solving romantic problems, and attracting money…

npcs.name: Egg Woman
says: I have here an EGG. I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in hot sand by the hot springs. But that doesn't seem to be enough… I've heard it would be best if it were kept together with POKéMON and carried about. You are a TRAINER, yes? And your POKéMON radiate vitality. So, what say you? Will you take this EGG to hatch?
Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with this here EGG!
Every so often, an EGG will be found at the POKéMON DAY CARE. Or at least that's how the rumor goes.
As you wish, then… If you have a change of heart about hatching this EGG, I will be here.
Oh? You've too many POKéMON. There's no room for this EGG…

npcs.name: Sign
says: POKéMON HERB SHOP “Bitter taste--better cure!”

npcs.name: Sign
says: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: FLANNERY “One with a fiery passion that burns!”

npcs.name: Sign
says: LAVARIDGE TOWN “POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS An excellent place for relaxing!”

npcs.name: Flannery
says: Your power reminds me of someone… Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
FLANNERY: I lost the match, but I'm completely satisfied. It's not often I get to enjoy a battle this heated. Let's have another one like this again sometime!
That TM50 contains OVERHEAT. That move inflicts serious damage on the opponent. But it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK of the POKéMON using it. It might not be suitable for longer battles.

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound [name]? LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY uses FIRE-type POKéMON. Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger and hotter than a volcano. Don't get too close to her--you'll burn! Hose her down with water and then go for it!
Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!

npcs.name: Sign
says: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: [name]
LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM

npcs.name: Sign
says: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: [name]
LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM

npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Old Man
says: You've come to look at herbal medicine in LAVARIDGE? That's rather commendable. I like you! Take this!
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used for making herbal medicine. It also does wonders when held by a POKéMON. It intensifies the power of FIRE-type moves.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: Herbal medicine works impressively well. But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. It must be horribly bitter!

npcs.name: Old Man
says: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot springs. This is what she told me. She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE. And they discovered that EGG!

npcs.name: Zigzagoon
says: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!

npcs.name: Mimic Tutor
says: Ah, young one! I am also a young one, but I mimic the styles and speech of the elderly folks of this town. What do you say, young one? Would you agree to it if I were to offer to teach the move MIMIC?
Fwofwo! And so I shall! Let me see the POKéMON you wish me to teach.
MIMIC is a move of great depth. Could you execute it to perfection as well as me…?
Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC to your POKéMON!
This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?

npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Expert M
says: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's SPEED in battle. That will help it get in the first strike--a decided advantage!

npcs.name: Old Woman
says: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local specialty that you can buy only there. Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

Th-that card… Could it be… The GOLD CARD?! Oh, the gold color is brilliant! The four stars seem to sparkle! I've seen several TRAINERS with a SILVER CARD before, but, [name], you're the first TRAINER I've ever seen with a GOLD CARD! Okay, [name], please allow me the honor of resting your POKéMON!
I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
Thank you for waiting. We've restored your POKéMON to full health.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: It's sort of magical how just sitting in a hot-spring pool can invigorate. I wish I could let my POKéMON soak, too.

npcs.name: Woman
says: I think POKéMON get closer to their TRAINERS if they spend time together. The longer the better. That's what I think.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach the hot springs from here. If POKéMON are getting rest, so too should their TRAINERS.

npcs.name: Mystery Gift Man
says: Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System. You must be [name]. There is a ticket here for you.
It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port. Why not give it a try and see what it is about?

Ahoy, did you know? Someone punted TEAM AQUA out of the way for us! That got the WAILMER out of the cove, so we can get our boats out again.

npcs.name: Girl
says: Have you seen that strange cave in the cove at the edge of town?
I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new moves for entering a CONTEST. So, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER and make it forget HM moves.

npcs.name: Man3
says: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL right in this here town. That means well-raised POKéMON will come from all over the country. My heart swells with excitement!

npcs.name: Rich Boy
says: I came from KANTO. The HOENN region is beautiful with all its water and verdant nature. Hunh? Wait a second… Could there be rare POKéMON that live only in this area?

npcs.name: Man2
says: I'm an ART DEALER. I am a buyer and seller of fine art, especially paintings. I've heard that the MUSEUM here has magnificent works on exhibit…

npcs.name: Woman2
says: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the seaside inn to the sound of waves… When someone stole my POKéMON! Who's the abductor? TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?
My missing POKéMON… It came back without me noticing!

npcs.name: Expert M1
says: Even as we grow old and wrinkled, the sea remains forever young with the vivid brilliance of life… Fwohoho fwohohohoho…

npcs.name: Expert F
says: It was sixty years ago that my husband proposed to me here. The sea remains as beautiful as ever. Mufufufu mufufufufufu…

npcs.name: Expert M2
says: Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern in this cove? That had been a natural formation, but then that TEAM AQUA lot came along and made their renovations. They call themselves the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”! But what they do and what they say don't match at all!
That cave in the cove… I didn't notice it right away, but it's completely empty now. That TEAM AQUA lot, they must have gone away for good.

npcs.name: Wailmer Trainer Grunt
says: There! WAILMER! Leap out of the water now!
Hunh? What do you want? You're messing up our training, so can you, like, get lost?

npcs.name: Aqua Grunt4

npcs.name: Aqua Grunt1
says: Fufufu… We moved more loot into our secret HIDEOUT today… Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!

npcs.name: Aqua Grunt2
says: I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what the BOSS is thinking… But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get the chance to do big things! Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!

npcs.name: Aqua Grunt3

When it gets right down to it… The way dignified simplicity suits me, S perfectly suit POKéMON.

BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not going to lose to no [name].
MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can check out your POKéMON!

MAY: Oh, hey? [name], are you shopping, too? I bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and POSTERS. Of course, I've also caught a lot of POKéMON, and I'm raising them properly, too. Actually, I'm more worried if you're raising POKéMON properly, [name]. I'll battle with you, so you can show me your POKéMON, [name].
MAY: Oh, why? [name], haven't you been raising your POKéMON? That's not a very good showing as a TRAINER…
BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's been raising POKéMON better?
BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's [name]. I'm running an errand for my dad. No, I'm not buying any DOLLS. Anyways, it's been a while. Want to have a battle to see who's been raising POKéMON better?
BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter? Don't have the confidence?

npcs.name: School Kid M

People have to work together to get it to spin faster. The faster you can make it spin, the better S you can get, I've heard.
It's used for making a kind of candy called a . If you give a good to a POKéMON, its condition will improve by a lot.

npcs.name: Woman1

npcs.name: Man1

npcs.name: Sailor1

npcs.name: Fat Man

npcs.name: Girl
says: That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different S. Can you win if you had that many of those things?

npcs.name: Smart Contest MC

npcs.name: Smart Contest Judge
says: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST? Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!

npcs.name: Smart Contestant1
says: Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST. I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST… Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.

npcs.name: Smart Contestant2
says: I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart. It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON. My dear wife, are you seeing this?

npcs.name: Smart Contestant3
says: There it is! If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!

npcs.name: Smart Contestant4
says: Oh, dear, no! My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over! But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!

npcs.name: Smart Contest Audience1
says: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!

npcs.name: Smart Contest Audience4
says: When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS. That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.

npcs.name: Smart Contest Audience2
says: Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals. It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.

npcs.name: Beauty Contest MC
says: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!

npcs.name: Beauty Contest Judge
says: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty! Why, I almost forgot to score them!

npcs.name: Beauty Contestant1
says: A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it. Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.

npcs.name: Beauty Contestant2

npcs.name: Beauty Contestant3
says: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it. Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!

npcs.name: Beauty Contestant4
says: This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger. Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking. Did I say something funny?

npcs.name: Beauty Contest Audience1
says: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.

npcs.name: Beauty Contest Audience3
says: You can't always win on just beauty alone. You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.

npcs.name: Beauty Contest Audience2

npcs.name: Smart Contest Audience3
says: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.

npcs.name: Cute Contest Judge
says: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals! Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!

npcs.name: Cute Contestant1

npcs.name: Cute Contestant2

npcs.name: Cute Contestant3
says: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance. I won't let anyone disturb its performance.

npcs.name: Cute Contestant4
says: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute. However, if my POKéMON were to make a cute appeal… I'm sure that it would be so much cuter than the others.

npcs.name: Cute Contest Audience1
says: My child is in this CONTEST.
Come on, dear. Go for it! Your POKéMON is the best!

npcs.name: Cute Contest Audience3
says: I think that girl over there is the cutest of the lot. What's that? They're judging POKéMON by their looks?

npcs.name: Cute Contest Audience2
says: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, they make we want to get my own! I'm going to go catch some!

npcs.name: Sailor
says: Whoa, isn't this place humongous! The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.

npcs.name: Blender2 Man

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS, here I come. The world will know that my dearest POKéMON is the cutest being in all existence. The time has come! Uheheheh.

npcs.name: Girl
says: You can see a whole variety of POKéMON here. That's why I make this place a regular part of my daily stroll.

npcs.name: Artist
says: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is a feast for these eyes! Would you look at all the POKéMON that just scream to be painted?

npcs.name: Reporter

I'll be looking forward to your next POKéMON CONTEST.
Oh, you will? Thank you. Briefly, how would you describe the CONTEST you just entered?
Oh, too bad… Well, if you come across a good story, please do share it with me.
Ah, I see. That's a very edifying comment. You get a good feel for what the CONTEST was like. I've got one last question. When you hear the word “…,” what image do you get?

I see! So that's how you imagine the concept of “…” to be. Thank you! You've given me some good ideas. I think I can write a good story on POKéMON CONTESTS now. Maybe, just maybe, this story will even make it to television. I hope you'll look forward to it!

npcs.name: Blender3 Boy
says: Let's get blending already!

npcs.name: Blender2 Twin

npcs.name: Fisherman

npcs.name: Fat Man

npcs.name: Ninja Boy

I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM using that DYNAMICPUNCH!
Darn! You're even making fun of me? Punch! Punch! Punch!
This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?

npcs.name: Archie
says: ARCHIE: Grr, [name]! I should've guessed you'd show up! See for yourself what the fanatics of TEAM MAGMA are up to! They're trying to inject the stolen METEORITE's power into the volcano! Doing something like that will cause the volcano's eruption!
ARCHIE: Grrr… I want to stop that MAXIE, but I can't! Not when I have my hands full battling three opponents at once!

npcs.name: Maxie
says: The power contained in the METEORITE… By amplifying its power with this machine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic activity will instantly intensify… Its energy will grow deep inside the crater and… Fufufu…

MAXIE: Hm? Who are you? … … … … … … … … … … … … I'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's affairs. It must be you he meant. Humph! So you're thinking of interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA? Now you listen. Long ago, living things used the land to live and grow. That is why land is all important! It is the cradle of all! That is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated to the expansion of the land mass. It is for further advancement of humankind and POKéMON! And for that, we need the power of what sleeps within this mountain… Oh! There was no need for you to learn that much. But, no matter! I'll teach you the consequences of meddling in our grand design!
MAXIE: But, enough. I will back off this time. But don't think that this is the last you've seen of TEAM MAGMA. Fufufu… Even without the METEORITE, if we obtain that ORB… Fufufu…

ARCHIE: [name]! Thank you! With your help, we thwarted TEAM MAGMA's destructive plan! But… You… Whose side are you on? Ah, it doesn't matter. We will remain vigilant and keep up our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA. [name], we shall meet again!

npcs.name: Old Man
says: MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits of POKéMON that have passed on… This is a high place where one can see all of HOENN… The disembodied spirits of POKéMON must find solace here… Is it coincidence that you are here… Will you hear out my tale? A tale long told in the HOENN region?
It is my role to pass on the legends of HOENN to future generations. And the crisis that just ended in SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend… Have you the time to hear the new legend of HOENN?

It happened long, long ago… The world was wracked by a ferocious clash between the POKéMON of the land and the POKéMON of the sea… The POKéMON of the land raised mountains and created continents… The POKéMON of the sea raised huge waves and carved out oceans… Their fierce duel raged without end. The world was engulfed in massive infernos and vicious storms. The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought an end to the calamity. Light poured from the two ORBS and becalmed the enraged adversaries. The pair, made docile, dove deep into the sea where eventually they disappeared…
I see… Well, that, too, is fine…

It happened long, long ago… The world was wracked by a ferocious clash between the POKéMON of the land and the POKéMON of the sea… The POKéMON of the land raised mountains and created continents… The POKéMON of the sea raised huge waves and carved out oceans… Their fierce duel raged without end. The world was engulfed in massive fires and vicious storms. It was then that the POKéMON of the sky descended from a storm. The POKéMON, shining a vivid green, becalmed the two enraged POKéMON. Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON flew off into the wild blue yonder…

npcs.name: Old Lady
says: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by those sinister men… They must never be apart… I fear something terrible will happen…

The embodiments of the land, sea, and the sky… That is said to be the identities of the super-ancient POKéMON… In the same way that we humans and POKéMON have life, our world, too, is alive… The super-ancient POKéMON have taught us that…
The two men who took the ORBS came back to return them on their own. Those men… Perhaps they are not so evil after all…

Oh, my goodness… You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE have been awakened? It is said that the BLUE ORB and the RED ORB quelled the rage of the two POKéMON… It is also said that the true owner of the ORBS still exists. However, no one knows who, or what exactly, the ORBS belong to. It could be a human, or perhaps a POKéMON, but no one knows.

Which POKéMON's nickname should I critique?
I see. Do come visit again.
Hmmm… …, is it? That is quite a fine name you bestowed. But! What say you, if I were to suggest a slightly better name?
Now, now. That is merely an EGG!
Hmmm… … it is! This is a magnificent nickname! It is impeccably beyond reproach! You'll do well to cherish your … now and beyond.
Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as …! It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior! How fortunate for you!
Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as …! It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!

npcs.name: Museum Patron3

npcs.name: Museum Patron4

That TM, it suits you more than it does me. Hope I never see you again! Wahahaha!
Awww, come on! You have to take this and let me go!

says: Oh? Do you perhaps like POKéMON? I'm on assignment with the TV network. I'm gathering stories on POKéMON and TRAINERS that occurred recently. If you don't mind, could you tell me something about yourself?
Hmmm… I've got a good story for a TV program. I'd better write it up in a hurry!
I'm gathering stories on POKéMON and TRAINERS that occurred recently. If you don't mind, could you tell me something about yourself?
Oh, you will? Thank you! Then, please, tell me anything of interest that you experienced recently involving POKéMON.
Oh, I see… Well, if you do have an interesting story to tell, please let me know.
Oh, what an uplifting story! I'll be sure to get your story told on television. It should be aired sometime, I think, so please look forward to it.

npcs.name: Capt Stern
says: Yes? If you're looking for STERN, that would be me. Ah! Those must be the parts I ordered from MR. STONE of DEVON. Thank you! That's great! We can prepare for our expedition now.
Hehehe, hold it! We'll take those parts!
CAPT. STERN: Wh-what? Who are you people?
We're TEAM AQUA! Our BOSS wants those parts! Shut your yap and fork them over!
Oh, man, what a disaster… The BOSS is going to be furious…
Humph, sniveling wimp! Let me take care of this!
Now what? If we don't get the parts, we're in for it! Arrgh, I didn't count on being meddled with by some meddling kid!
I came to see what was taking so long to snatch some parts, and you simps are held up by a mere child?

We are TEAM AQUA, and we love the sea! And I am TEAM AQUA's leader, ARCHIE! What makes you interfere with us? …No! You can't be! You're not one of TEAM MAGMA? Wait, that can't be right. You're not dressed for the part. … … … … … … … … … … … … POKéMON, people… All life depends on the sea. So, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to the expansion of the sea. Don't you agree? What we are doing is a magnificent undertaking. Ah, fine… You're still too young to understand our noble objective. But, I warn you, don't even consider interfering with our plans again. The consequences will cost you dearly! And don't you forget it!
CAPT. STERN: You're… Ah, okay, you're [name]… Anyway, that was a tense situation! Thank you for saving us! Oh, yes, I almost forgot that you even brought the parts from DEVON!

CAPT. STERN: Whoops! There's no time to lose! We have to set out on our ocean-floor expedition really soon. Thanks again, but now I've got to go! Feel free to wander around and check out our facilities, though.

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

Th-that card… Could it be… The GOLD CARD?! Oh, the gold color is brilliant! The four stars seem to sparkle! I've seen several TRAINERS with a SILVER CARD before, but, [name], you're the first TRAINER I've ever seen with a GOLD CARD! Okay, [name], please allow me the honor of resting your POKéMON!
I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
Thank you for waiting. We've restored your POKéMON to full health.

npcs.name: Sailor
says: Want a tip for battling? I'd say it's raising different kinds of POKéMON in a balanced manner. It's no good to make just one POKéMON strong. If it has a type disadvantage, it might not stand a chance.

npcs.name: Woman
says: I trade POKéMON with my friends. If a traded POKéMON is holding an item, it makes me twice as happy!

npcs.name: Mystery Gift Man
says: Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System. You must be [name]. There is a ticket here for you.
It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port. Why not give it a try and see what it is about?

npcs.name: Man
says: If you keep letting a POKéMON faint in battle, it'll come to resent it. Soon, it will become less trusting of the TRAINER. In other words, it certainly won't like you very much.

npcs.name: Twin
says: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used on them? Mine acted really happy when I gave it some PROTEIN.

npcs.name: Reporter
says: Wow! It's plain to see that you lavish your love on your …. Okay, it's named …. Can I ask you a favor? I'm a TV reporter, and I'm running a survey on POKéMON. Would you be willing to answer a few simple questions for me?
Hi, you seem to be very close to your …. Do you know what? I'm a TV reporter. I travel around interviewing people about POKéMON. I'm wondering if you'd be willing to tell me a little about your …?
I enjoy this job--you get to learn about POKéMON by doing interviews.
Great! Thank you! Okay, here goes. I just need quick answers, okay?
Oh, okay… Well, if you get the urge to tell me about POKéMON, I'll be here!
Wow, thank you! Okay, then, please tell me anything you'd like about your ….

Wow… That's an interesting account. You really are tight with …, aren't you? I get the feeling that your account will make a great TV story. I promise that I'll turn this into an entertaining show. Keep your eyes out for it. Okay, that's all. Bye-bye!

npcs.name: Soothe Bell Woman
says: I love seeing POKéMON that love their TRAINERS. POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS. If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back. When your POKéMON grow to love you, please come show me.
POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS. If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back.
Your POKéMON really adores you. For you, a most compassionate TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!

npcs.name: Chairman
says: Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the POKéMON FAN CLUB! Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally the most important! No one can best me when it comes to raising POKéMON. No one! Well, let me tell you about POKéMON CONTESTS. They're events where one can show off POKéMON for the world to see! However, they're held in far-off towns, so I cannot participate often enough. That is why we gather here to show off our POKéMON, and have others show us theirs.
The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has entered a POKéMON CONTEST… That, I would like to see.

npcs.name: Zigzagoon
says: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…

npcs.name: Skitty
says: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…

npcs.name: Azumarill
says: AZUMARILL: Marimari?

npcs.name: Swagger Tutor
says: Heh! My POKéMON totally rules! It's cooler than any POKéMON! I was lipping off with a swagger in my step like that when the CHAIRMAN chewed me out. That took the swagger out of my step. If you'd like, I'll teach the move SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.
All right, which POKéMON wants to learn how to SWAGGER?
I'll just praise my POKéMON from now on without the swagger.
What, no? Can't you get into the spirit of things?
This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?

npcs.name: Dock
says: Umm… If this goes here, and that goes over there… Then where does this thing go? And what about that doohickey? Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails of this!

Hm? Hi, I'm DOCK. CAPT. STERN commissioned me to design a ferry. Oh! That there… Are they DEVON GOODS? But, hmm… This won't do… CAPT. STERN went off somewhere. He said he had some work to do. Could I get you to go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that to him?

DOCK: The ferry is finally ready! The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel of technology! But, I get the feeling that we can make something even better. You know, there's never an end to technology's march.
DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help. Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.
DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art. A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating. I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…
DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have gone off to? Could you go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that parcel to him?

npcs.name: Scientist1
says: The seasons, the weather, where the moon sits in the sky… These and other conditions make the sea change its expression. That's right! The sea is like a living thing!

npcs.name: Scientist2
says: I get seasick real easily. So I get to help out here instead.

npcs.name: Briney
says: MR. BRINEY: Ah, [name]! It's been too long! Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky! So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry. Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people. But, you know, that DOCK is really something special. With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!

npcs.name: Scientist1
says: Designing a large ship is more like making a big building than putting together a transportation vehicle.

npcs.name: Scientist2
says: Don't you think it's strange that a ship made of heavy iron floats? It floats because of a principle called buoyancy.

npcs.name: Cave Of Origin Expert
says: Who might you be? This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN. The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here. Please leave.
This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN… With the passing of the crisis, the cave, too, shall sleep…
Oh, my… The clash between the two awakened POKéMON was quelled by the awakening of a third POKéMON…

A person with a strong will and superior talent… A TRAINER who has knowledge and experience of many kinds of POKéMON… If such a person were to appear, I was instructed by WALLACE to lead that TRAINER to this CAVE.

npcs.name: Woman2
says: The weather was clear this morning, but… All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, rain started falling in sheets, and there was thunder and lightning, too. The weather just went completely wild! Is all of this because of those POKéMON?
Oh? It was you who brought that flying POKéMON here? Well, aren't you amazing!

npcs.name: Kiri
says: A big POKéMON is fighting with another big POKéMON! Please, someone make them stop!

Hi, what's your name? … … … … … … … … … Okay. That's nice! My name is KIRI. My mommy and daddy named me that so I would grow healthy and warmhearted. That's what they wished. You can have one of these.
KIRI will give you this BERRY, too! I really like it lots!
A pretty POKéMON came down from the sky…
Spring, summer, autumn, and winter. If you're born in springtime, do you like the spring, and if you're born in the summer, do you like the summer?
Oh… It doesn't matter… There's so much that I want to know…
I wonder what kind of wish is included in your name.
Then KIRI was born in the autumn, so I love the autumn! Which season do you like?

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: Wow! This is wicked!
Wow! That was wicked!
I… I've never been out of this city. I wonder what the world is like on the other side of this round sky?

npcs.name: Boy1
says: These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared in the middle of the city! And, I've never seen them before! Why are they smashing into each other like that? Why can't they be friends, those POKéMON?
What? What? What? What is that green POKéMON?!
GROUDON and KYOGRE… Where did they go? Will they cause droughts or downpours somewhere else?
Diving in the sea. Climbing up and down stairs all the time… If you live in this town, you end up getting physically fit.

npcs.name: Man
says: Hm! You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS? You're no ordinary tourist. But I suppose that doesn't make you an extraordinary tourist, either.
The city has regained its calm…

npcs.name: Steven
says: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA… It's incredible how the two rampaging POKéMON would flee from it in fear…

STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting… GROUDON… And KYOGRE… The two super-ancient POKéMON were awakened from a long sleep… And now they are smashing each other with their uncontrollable energy… …[name]. You being here now I'll take to mean that you're prepared to become involved in this crisis. Well, then, there's someone that I'd like you to meet. Come with me, please.
STEVEN: Listen, [name]. Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make you think POKéMON are to be feared? But that's not true. POKéMON are really more… …Why am I asking you this? You already know.
STEVEN: Okay, here we are! Inside here you'll find someone named WALLACE. I think you have what's needed to help him…
STEVEN: I think you have what's needed to help him…
STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR… I've never been there. I wonder where it could be?
STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and ARCHIE have gone away somewhere. Perhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to return those ORBS…

npcs.name: Woman1
says: SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in the crater of a volcano. If you look up at the sky, the lip of the crater is also visible. So, all you see is the sky in a circle. But that's what makes the sky above SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.
A circle of a night sky framed by the crater of a volcano… And in that ring, stars flicker and blink as if they were alive… It's my favorite scenery.
When that third POKéMON flew down, I feared the worst.
When two POKéMON that gigantic are fighting that savagely, there's not much that we can do.

npcs.name: Maniac
says: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON. Well, I'm seeing that happen with my very own eyes! Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!

There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON. Well, I saw that happen with my very own eyes! Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!

npcs.name: Girl
says: Oh, no! SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!
SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: Go for it, red POKéMON! Don't back off, blue POKéMON!
… … … … … … Hi, do you know the names of those POKéMON fighting over there?
I was wondering which one would win, the red one or the blue one, but, oh no, it's the green one that settles things! Talk about a huge turn of events!

npcs.name: Boy2
says: I just get this sense somehow that the two POKéMON aren't angry. I think… They probably can't control their own power…
That flying POKéMON came down from the sky and stopped the rampaging POKéMON…

npcs.name: Maxie
says: MAXIE: G… GROUDON… Please! Stop what you're doing! I know the extent of your power now! If you keep going, all HOENN, not just SOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!

MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE… After all our fruitless scheming and frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's simple action puts everything right again as if nothing had happened… Fu… Fuhahaha…

npcs.name: Archie
says: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?! Look over here! It's the RED ORB! Calm down! KYOGRE! … … … … … … … … … … … … It's no good! It's not responding at all!

ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both flew off to who knows where. The weather in HOENN has returned to its normal state… Haha… Hahaha… Maybe what we were trying to do was something small, even meaningless, to POKéMON…

npcs.name: Wallace
says: WALLACE: [name]… The leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA, I don't think they meant harm. It wouldn't hurt to hear what they have to say for themselves.
WALLACE: Oh? [name]? Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR yet? I'm sure that you can make it to the top of the SKY PILLAR…
WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be dazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly elegant battle style.
WALLACE: [name]… My eyes didn't deceive me. Thanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS… No, all of HOENN was saved. On behalf of the people, I thank you. This is a gift from me. Please accept it.

That HIDDEN MACHINE contains WATERFALL. If you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON that has learned that HM move can force its way up waterfalls. And where does one get the RAIN BADGE? You know, don't you? That's right! You have to beat the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER. When you're all set to go, step through that door.

npcs.name: Sign
says: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: JUAN “The GYM LEADER with the beauty of pure water!”

npcs.name: Sign
says: SOOTOPOLIS CITY “The mystical city where history slumbers.”

npcs.name: Juan
says: The TRAINERS who have gathered all the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make way to the ultimate destination. The POKéMON LEAGUE. Travel to the easternmost reaches of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE. There, you shall find the POKéMON LEAGUE.

JUAN: If I told you to become my apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure. I would like to make a gift of my coat to you. But again, you will refuse. I imagine that to be so. And that, my friend, is a certain sign of nobility!
The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you contains WATER PULSE. In use, it will occasionally confuse the target with ultrasonic waves. … … … … … …
There remains but one BADGE to obtain in HOENN. If you wish to challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE, you must obtain the last BADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION- bound [name]? SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is a master of WATER-type POKéMON. And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor will hamper your progress… Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the advice that I have for you. The rest of the way, you have to go for it yourself!
Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who was supposedly the best in all HOENN! Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD. If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!

npcs.name: Sign
says: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: [name]
SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM

says: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: [name]
SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM

npcs.name: Brick Break Black Belt
says: For thirty years I've remained in SOOTOPOLIS honing my skills. I developed a shattering TM. I bequeath it to you!
TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move so horrible that I can't describe it.

npcs.name: Kecleon
says: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.

npcs.name: Expert F
says: MT. PYRE… At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?
Yes, two orbs side by side… The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…
Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…

npcs.name: Woman
says: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you? SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. Even more than his student WALLACE! Do you have any?
Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome. Try working a little harder to get a fan following.
Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

npcs.name: Girl
says: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN. It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

npcs.name: Man
says: Listen up, and I'll tell you something good. There's supposed to be an ancient ruin in the sea around here. There could be treasures just waiting to be discovered down there.

npcs.name: Woman
says: Ancient treasures… It would be nice if they existed, but even if they didn't, it would be so beautiful to take an underwater stroll with my POKéMON.

npcs.name: Azumarill
says: AZUMARILL: Marurii.

npcs.name: Maniac
says: There appears to be some connection between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE. My friends and I did some research on it at the lab where I used to work.

npcs.name: Girl
says: My big brother used to study the sea.

npcs.name: Woman
says: Hello! You're our first guest in a good while. You've brightened up my day, so I'll give you a big WAILMER DOLL.
Take good care of it!
I love plush DOLLS!
Are you sure? You don't want this DOLL?
Too bad! There's no room left for another ……
Oh, you want it, but not right now? Okay, then I'll hold it for you.

npcs.name: Old Man
says: An underwater volcano erupted and forced itself up from the depths. Its crater emerged from the sea and became filled with rainwater. That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into being.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and the outside world… It seems as if the cave was made to keep something from getting out. Or am I just imagining things?

npcs.name: Lotad Brother
says: Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD? It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS. I love, I mean love, big LOTAD! My big brother says that SEEDOT is bigger. But that's wrong! Everyone knows that LOTAD is a lot bigger. Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD? P-p-please show me!
Don't you have a big LOTAD? How disappointing… If you get a big LOTAD, please come show me!
Well, isn't this something! But it's no LOTAD!
… inches? Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD than this one here.
… inches! Wow, that is big! It might be even bigger than the huge SEEDOT my big brother saw. Thanks for showing me! This is my thanks!
Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.

npcs.name: Seedot Brother
says: Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT? It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS. Anyway, I love big SEEDOT. The bigger the better. But my younger brother, he says that LOTAD is bigger. That's silly. SEEDOT has to be bigger than that! Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you? P-p-please, show me!
You don't have a big SEEDOT? That's too bad… If you get a big SEEDOT, please come show me.
Oh, now this is quite something… But it's not a SEEDOT!
… inches, is it? Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT than this one.
… inches! Oh, my gosh, this is a big one! It might even beat the big LOTAD my younger brother saw! Thanks for showing me. This is my thanks!
Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.

npcs.name: Sign
says: The biggest SEEDOT in history! …'s …-inch giant! A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD always wanted!

npcs.name: Sign
says: The biggest LOTAD in history! …'s …-inch colossus! A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT always wanted!

npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Fat Man
says: What… What is happening? I really want to know, but it's too scary to go outside.
PP UP is great! It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, of a POKéMON move.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: This weather… Did something awaken?
Do you know FULL RESTORE? Full restoration of HP! Eradication of all status problems! It's truly an item of your dreams!

npcs.name: Old Man
says: When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER. Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.
A TRAINER named … is visiting my home. Would you like to challenge …?
Before you two battle, you should save your progress.
I hope to see a good match!
You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…
Oh, good, good! But my house isn't all that sturdy. Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

Th-that card… Could it be… The GOLD CARD?! Oh, the gold color is brilliant! The four stars seem to sparkle! I've seen several TRAINERS with a SILVER CARD before, but, [name], you're the first TRAINER I've ever seen with a GOLD CARD! Okay, [name], please allow me the honor of resting your POKéMON!
I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
Thank you for waiting. We've restored your POKéMON to full health.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes. Even I would rather not venture outside.

WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest TRAINER in the whole HOENN region. This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER who taught WALLACE. But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be even stronger than WALLACE's mentor. How strong could they be?

npcs.name: Woman
says: Aren't POKéMON our friends? Why are they going wild this way?
Whenever, wherever, and whatever happens, I will always be friends with POKéMON. Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!

npcs.name: Double Edge Tutor
says: Sigh… SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really lovably admirable. But that also means I have many rivals for his attention. He's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE. I couldn't even catch his eye. Please, let me teach your POKéMON the move DOUBLE-EDGE!
Okay, which POKéMON should I teach DOUBLE-EDGE?
I won't live for love anymore! I'll become tough!
Oh… Even you rejected me…
This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?

npcs.name: Mystery Gift Man
says: Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System. You must be [name]. There is a ticket here for you.
It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port. Why not give it a try and see what it is about?

npcs.name: Sailor
says: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to see or do on this forgettable island. What say we sail back to LILYCOVE?
Aye, right, then! Sail home we will!
Aye, right, as you like, then.

npcs.name: Sign
says: “Those whose memories fade seek to carve them in their hearts…”

npcs.name: Sign
says: “All dreams are but another reality. Never forget…”

npcs.name: Hideout Entrance Grunt1
says: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA? Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to snatch something important! … … Where did he go? Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA? Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to jack a submarine! … … Where did he go? Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? I hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to awaken an awesome POKéMON at their HIDEOUT. But where might their HIDEOUT be?

npcs.name: Hideout Entrance Grunt2
says: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA? Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122! … … Why did he go? Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA? Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY! … … Why did he go? Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? I hear that TEAM MAGMA is after an awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY. But what is that POKéMON like?

npcs.name: Matt
says: Hehehe! Our BOSS has already gone on his way to some cave under the sea! If you're going to give chase, you'd better search the big, wide sea beyond LILYCOVE. But will you find it then? Hehehe!

npcs.name: Maxie
says: MAXIE: GROUDON… Nothing could awaken you from your sleep bathed in magma… This BLUE ORB is what you sought. Wasn't it? I have brought you the BLUE ORB. Let its shine awaken you! And show me… Show me the full extent of your power!
MAXIE: GROUDON! What's wrong? Wasn't the BLUE ORB the key? GROUDON! Where have you gone…
MAXIE: Oh, so it was you? I've seen you poking around uninvited here and there… I get it now! You must have pulled a cheap stunt!

MAXIE: There has to be some reason why GROUDON fled… That's what you're trying to say, aren't you? … … … … … … … … … … … … Humph… You think I didn't know that? With GROUDON gone, there is no longer any need for this blasted volcano. I am going after GROUDON, so this is where we part!

Entrance Poké Mart · after the game starts

npcs.name: Attendant
says: I hope you give it your best.
Thank you for playing!

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
