npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Girl
says: Do you see the Time Board over there? My friends and I are trying to see who can reach the top in the least time.
Do you know when they're opening this place up? I'm waiting here to be the first challenger ever!

npcs.name: Man
says: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS and POKéMON combos are ahead? All I know is that I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!
I heard tough TRAINERS come to this TRAINER HILL from all over. I can't wait to test the waters! I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!

items.where: Battle Tent Lobby: given by Attract Giver
Pokemon Center 2 F: given by Mystery Gift Man

npcs.name: Man
says: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction. The air is clean and delicious here. Living here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.

npcs.name: Twin
says: My papa told me. He says this tunnel is full of timid POKéMON. They get all scared of loud noise and make a big uproar. So they had to stop the big tunnel project. But there's one man. He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!
There was a man who dug a tunnel for a lady he loved. I don't really get it, but hey!

npcs.name: Boy
says: Did you see the cave next to the POKéMON MART? There's a guy in there who's trying to bust up boulders so he can bust out through to the other side. It'd be great if we could go through… It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.
That cave next to the POKéMON MART is now a tunnel to the other side. It's great--it's easy to go shop for new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.

npcs.name: Camper
says: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding a hot winning streak. So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT debut in this town.

npcs.name: Sign
says: VERDANTURF TOWN “The windswept highlands with the sweet fragrance of grass.”

npcs.name: Sign
says: WANDA'S HOUSE

npcs.name: Sign
says: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”

npcs.name: Sign
says: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF “The tunnel project has been canceled.”

npcs.name: Attendant
says: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE! Here, the TRAINER's trust toward POKéMON is tested.
To achieve a 3-win streak… The bonds that bind your heart with your POKéMON seem firm and true.
For the feat of your 3-win streak, we present you with this prize.
When you have fortified your heart and POKéMON, you must return.

npcs.name: Attract Giver
says: My feelings toward my POKéMON… The attraction runs deep… Oh, hi, you didn't see that, did you? Well, it doesn't matter. How would you like this TM for your POKéMON?
My feelings toward my POKéMON… I'm sure the attraction is mutual! They battle exactly the way I want them to!

npcs.name: Boy1
says: What kind of moves have you taught your POKéMON? I think you would give yourself an advantage if they knew how to heal or protect themselves.

npcs.name: Boy2
says: If it doesn't like a certain move, a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it. It doesn't matter how strong it is, either. For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE nature probably won't enjoy hurting its opponents. If it can't seem to live up to its potential, it's probably failing at using a disliked move against its will.

npcs.name: Scott
says: SCOTT: Hey there, [name]! I thought I might see you here. A BATTLE TENT's a place where you can meet tough TRAINERS. It doesn't matter what the rules are, or how battles are waged, either. [name], I expect you to do the best you can!
SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes of seeing tough TRAINERS in action in whatever the situation.

npcs.name: Little Boy
says: My big sister is gentle usually. But when she gets angry, she's really, really scary! I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary if it gets angry!

npcs.name: Sign
says: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.

npcs.name: Friendship Rater
says: Let me see your POKéMON. I'll check to see how much it likes you. Oh. Your POKéMON…

npcs.name: Pikachu
says: PIKACHU: Pika pika!

npcs.name: Woman1
says: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, is the POKéMON LEAGUE. The TRAINERS who gather there are all frighteningly well skilled.

npcs.name: Woman2
says: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the rules say that you have to battle the ELITE FOUR all in a row. If you lose to any of them, you have to begin your challenge again from the first one.

npcs.name: Clerk
says: Please come again!

npcs.name: Boy
says: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL is crucial. It jacks up the power of some moves even though it's only for one battle.

npcs.name: Expert F
says: They don't seem to sell any winning strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT… It seems one must rely on one's own wits after all…

npcs.name: Lass
says: The NEST BALL works better on weakened POKéMON. VERDANTURF is the only place you can buy it.

npcs.name: Nurse
says: Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to rest your POKéMON?
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER. We restore your tired POKéMON to full health. Would you like to…

Th-that card… Could it be… The GOLD CARD?! Oh, the gold color is brilliant! The four stars seem to sparkle! I've seen several TRAINERS with a SILVER CARD before, but, [name], you're the first TRAINER I've ever seen with a GOLD CARD! Okay, [name], please allow me the honor of resting your POKéMON!
I'm delighted to see you, [name]! You want the usual, am I right?
Thank you for waiting. We've restored your POKéMON to full health.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: You can't consider yourself a real TRAINER if you don't have faith in your POKéMON. Only those people who can believe in their battling POKéMON can win through to the very end.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: The reason why anyone would visit VERDANTURF… It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without saying. Or is there somebody here that you came to see?

npcs.name: Fury Cutter Tutor
says: There's a move that gets stronger when you keep using it in a row. It's a BUG-type move, and it is wickedly cool. It's called FURY CUTTER. Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?
Yay! Show me which POKéMON I should teach.
I get a thrill watching to see if the move keeps hitting in succession!
We're not on the same wavelength.
This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?

npcs.name: Mystery Gift Man
says: Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System. You must be [name]. There is a ticket here for you.
It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port. Why not give it a try and see what it is about?

npcs.name: Wally
says: WALLY: I lost to you, [name], but I'm not feeling down anymore. Because I have a new purpose in life. Together with my RALTS, I'm going to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become a great TRAINER. Please watch me, [name]. I'm going to be stronger than you. When I do, I'm going to challenge you to another battle.
WALLY: Please watch me, [name]. I'm going to get stronger than you. When I do, I'm going to challenge you to another battle.

npcs.name: Wandas Boyfriend
says: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend every day. Happy? You bet I am!

npcs.name: Wallys Uncle
says: UNCLE: Oh! [name]! WALLY's next door. But, boy, there's something I have to tell you. This natural environment is doing wonders for WALLY's health. Maybe it's not just the environment. It could be POKéMON that are giving the boy hope.
UNCLE: Is that right? WALLY's gone away that far all by himself… Well, I have to give him credit--he is my little brother's son.
WALLY's gone away… He slipped off on his own…

npcs.name: Wallys Aunt
says: My daughter's boyfriend is a very driven and passionate sort of person. He's been digging a tunnel nonstop just so he can see my daughter. My daughter's a little concerned, so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.
WALLY was in EVER GRANDE? His parents in PETALBURG would be astonished to hear that!
If anything were to happen to WALLY, I would never be able to look his parents in PETALBURG in the eye…
It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend was digging the tunnel by hand! It's so incredible!

npcs.name: Wanda
says: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY. He'll be just fine. I know my little cousin, and he has POKéMON with him, too.
WANDA: You are? Oh, right, I get it! You're the [name] who WALLY was telling me about. I'm WALLY's cousin. Glad to meet you! I think WALLY's become a lot more lively and healthy since he came here.
